status: CI5 confirmed the checked executable-byte mutation also returns NOSIGNATURE. Independent authenticated-CMS versus native Windows SIP digest comparison is implemented and typechecked; fresh native Windows execution remains required.

ci5_failure.result: 1 test; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0.33s. The real validated executable-section byte was rejected as0x800b0100, failing the required0x80096010 category.
ci5_failure.conclusion: DOS-stub structure alone does not explain the generic WinTrust result. It is insufficient to claim an explicit image-digest comparison from that error. NOSIGNATURE is still not accepted as BAD_DIGEST evidence.

observed_failure.interpretation: Windows rejected the altered DOS-stub image. The test incorrectly required this structural mutation to reach the image-digest comparison. This observation is not evidence that a changed signed image was accepted.
observed_failure.earlier_checks: Signing, verification of the original file against the pinned certificate, and rejection of the wrong certificate pin completed before this control. The failure stopped the remaining file loop.

change.legacy_control: The byte-64 mutation remains a separate categorical rejection check. It contributes no BAD_DIGEST evidence.
change.digest_control: A read-only PE32/PE32+ selector validates DOS/PE/COFF headers, bounded optional header and data directories, complete section table, SizeOfHeaders, aligned bounded certificate table, and nonoverlapping bounded raw section ranges. It selects a byte inside a nonempty raw section having both code and executable characteristics, outside all headers and before the certificate table. The original and modified certificate blobs must remain identical.
change.strict_policy: The selected executable-byte mutation must produce exactly TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST. TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE, another error, or successful verification still fails. Original-file verification, exact certificate pinning and wrong-pin rejection remain in the same signing loop. No trust-store or verification-policy bypass was added.
change.test_inventory: No test names or counts were added. Portable parser controls are folded into the existing ReleaseIdentity case; its Windows branch still signs and verifies the real compiled executables.

native_sip_comparison.authentication_order: The existing exact pinned certificate and CryptMsgControl CMS signature checks complete before expected content is read. After explicit image-digest comparison, unchanged WinVerifyTrust policy must still succeed for valid files.
native_sip_comparison.expected_digest: Require exact Authenticode inner-content OID, exact bounded DER envelope, PE-image data OID, SHA256 algorithm OID and32-byte digest. CryptDecodeObject uses default copying flags into aligned owned storage; all nested reads use checked offsets into that allocation.
native_sip_comparison.actual_digest: Windows CryptSIPRetrieveSubjectGuid and CryptSIPCreateIndirectData compute the actual PE image digest with an ephemeral RSA/AES CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT SHA256 provider. No custom Authenticode hash algorithm, persistent key container or trust-store mutation is introduced.
native_sip_comparison.returned_algorithm: Accept a returned SHA256 OID only as a checked string inside the owned output allocation or an exact alias of the still-live caller-owned SHA256+NUL input. Unknown/static/out-of-range pointers are refused safely without dereferencing them.
native_sip_comparison.error_policy: Only explicit inequality between authenticated expected and independently computed actual SHA256 bytes produces TrustFailure(BAD_DIGEST). Generic decoder, provider, parameter and pointer failures remain errors of their own category. NOSIGNATURE remains a failure.
native_sip_comparison.controls: The same existing Windows ReleaseIdentity case now includes actual native decode of independent literal DER, every truncated prefix, malformed/OID/hash-length/trailing/noncanonical framing controls, buffer-size/pointer/returned-algorithm checks, and actual missing/non-PE provider failures. Those controls precede the mandatory real three-PE signing and verification loop.
native_sip_comparison.local_validation: Actual platform.rs+pe.rs+sip.rs and featuretest-support controls passed MSVC-target strict Clippy in5.82s. Linux typechecking does not execute Windows cryptographic APIs.
